column1: # key.tsv: the "Quem novit" letter key (KEY_B), simple substitution. Same values as key_B.txt (md5 224da5d5d7fea3c20ef63e1efe655b2e; that file is in the stamped manifest of 12 Nov 2026 02:25:10 GMT, sha256 fd3b7b4a...).
